name: Complex Regional Pain Syndrome
definition: Disproportionate regional pain syndrome with sensory, vasomotor, sudomotor/edema and motor/trophic abnormalities, often after injury or surgery.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical after excluding important alternatives.
investigations.MRI: MRI/bone scan is not diagnostic but may help exclude other pathology.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs may show late regional osteopenia but are nonspecific.

amber: Medication, blocks or neuromodulation require pain-specialist assessment; prolonged immobilization is usually harmful.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/vedana and autonomic-type phenotype may be documented without replacing Budapest clinical diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Disproportionate regional pain syndrome with sensory, vasomotor, sudomotor/edema and motor/trophic abnormalities, often after injury or surgery.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
